message.content:
The image shows a "movie barcode" which represents the average color of every few seconds of a film. The dominant colors here are dark greys, blacks, and muted teals/greens.

This palette is highly characteristic of **Apollo 18 (2011)**. Furthermore, the film relies heavily on night-vision and low-light camera footage, which introduces the specific greenish/cyan hues seen in the stripes. The other options generally have warmer tones (period pieces, deserts), more varied color palettes (suburban settings), or distinct reds/blues not present here.

Answer: C
